invitations_accepted_consistent.name: invitations_accepted_consistent
invitations_accepted_consistent.value: "invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' OR ("invitations"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

workflow_runs_finished_consistent.name: workflow_runs_finished_consistent
workflow_runs_finished_consistent.value:
("workflow_runs"."status" IN ('queued', 'running') AND "workflow_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("workflow_runs"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'timed_out') AND "workflow_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
